verses.text: Finally, brothers and sisters, we ask you and urge you in the Lord Jesus: we taught you how to live in order to please God. Keep doing this more and more.
You know what instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.
God wants you to be holy. He wants you to keep away from sexual sin.
Each of you should learn to control his own body in a way that is holy and honourable,
not with selfish desire, like the Gentiles who do not know God.
In this matter no one should wrong a brother or sister or take advantage of them. The Lord will punish people for all these things, as we told you and warned you before.
God did not call us to live impure lives, but holy lives.
So anyone who rejects this teaching is not rejecting a human being, but God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
You do not need anyone to write to you about loving your brothers and sisters, because God himself has taught you to love each other.
And you do love all the brothers and sisters all over Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers and sisters, to do it more and more.
Make it your aim to live a quiet life, to mind your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we told you.
Then outsiders will respect the way you live, and you will not need to depend on anyone.
Brothers and sisters, we want you to know about those who have died, so that you do not grieve like other people who have no hope.
We believe that Jesus died and rose again. So we believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have died believing in him.
Here is what the Lord's own message tells us: we who are still alive when the Lord comes will certainly not go before those who have died.
The Lord himself will come down from heaven with a loud command, with the voice of the archangel and with the sound of God's trumpet. And those who died believing in Christ will rise first.
After that, we who are still alive will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will be with the Lord for ever.
So comfort each other with these words.
